title: Crestline Fleet Account Credit Utilization Adjustment to the Late-Charge Rate
content:
The late-charge rate on a Crestline Fleet Account moves with how much of the credit limit the account is using.

| The account's balance compared with its credit limit | Credit utilization adjustment |
|---|---|
| no more than a quarter (25 percent) of the limit | minus 0.25 |
| more than three quarters (75 percent) of the limit | plus 0.25 |
| otherwise | nothing |

The account's balance is all invoices and late charges less all remittances, early-pay discounts and credit memos on the account; the credit limit is the account's own.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical credit limit of 20000.00)

| Balance | Share of limit | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 | exactly a quarter | minus 0.25 |
| 5000.01 | above a quarter | nothing |
| 15000.00 | exactly three quarters | nothing |
| 15000.01 | above three quarters | plus 0.25 |

The adjustment is in percentage points and is added to the late-charge rate, the percent charged on the day the charge is assessed; a program whose monthly late-charge percent is 0 charges nothing, whatever is added to the late-charge rate.
